articles.summary: DineSafe participated in and spoke at the Data & AI in Food Safety Workshop, held as part of the 130th Annual Educational Conference of the Association of Food and Drug Officials on June 5, 2026, at the Hyatt Regency Columbus.
articles.title: DineSafe Spoke at the 130th AFDO Annual Educational Conference

articles.summary: DineSafe recently participated in a podcast episode of Predictably Good webinar a Creme Global series episode with Patrick Quade, on April 20th, 2026 and hosted by Cronan McNamara, where they explored the evolving role of data and technology in modern food safety systems.
articles.title: DineSafe Participates in Predictably Good Webinar on Early Warning Signal & Predictive Analytics in Outbreak
